british/scramble.speaker: control
british/scramble.text: Scramble! Scramble! Bandits forming up over Cap Gris-Nez. Good luck, Red Section.

british/scramble_again.speaker: control
british/scramble_again.text: Red Leader, you are clear for take-off. Scramble!

british/raid_forming.speaker: control
british/raid_forming.text: Sector Control. Radar reports a new raid forming over France.

british/mosquito_strike.speaker: control
british/mosquito_strike.text: Sector Control. Mosquito squadron taking off for a low-level strike.

british/sweep.speaker: control
british/sweep.text: Sector Control. Fighters going over for a sweep and strafe.

british/enemy_sweep.speaker: control
british/enemy_sweep.text: Sector Control. Enemy fighters heading for Hawkinge. Expect strafing.

british/air_raid.speaker: control
british/air_raid.text: Hawkinge. Air raid warning red! Bombers overhead! Take cover!

british/hangar_lost.speaker: control
british/hangar_lost.text: Hawkinge here. A hangar has been destroyed!

british/runway_hit.speaker: control
british/runway_hit.text: Hawkinge here. The runway has been hit, but we can still get aircraft off.

british/runway_closed.speaker: control
british/runway_closed.text: Hawkinge here. The runway is closed. No more take-offs!

british/runway_unserviceable.speaker: control
british/runway_unserviceable.text: Hawkinge here. The runway is unserviceable.

british/enemy_runway_hit.speaker: control
british/enemy_runway_hit.text: Enemy runway cratered. Keep it up!

british/enemy_runway_closed.speaker: control
british/enemy_runway_closed.text: Enemy runway closed. They can no longer take off!

british/parked_lost.speaker: control
british/parked_lost.text: Hawkinge here. Aircraft destroyed on the ground!

british/parked_kill.speaker: control
british/parked_kill.text: Parked enemy aircraft destroyed. Well done!

british/kill_fuel.speaker: control
british/kill_fuel.text: Enemy fuel store destroyed. That will burn for hours.

british/rearmed.speaker: crew
british/rearmed.text: Rearmed, refuelled and patched up. Good hunting, sir!

british/victory.speaker: control
british/victory.text: All aircraft, all aircraft. The enemy airfield is finished. Magnificent work. Come on home.

british/defeat.speaker: control
british/defeat.text: All aircraft. Hawkinge is lost. I say again, Hawkinge is lost.

british/order_cover.speaker: you
british/order_cover.text: Red Section, form up on me!

british/player_down.speaker: wing
british/player_down.text: Red Leader is hit! Get out, sir, get out!

british/bandits_1.speaker: control
british/bandits_1.text: Sector Control. one bandit inbound. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_1_b.speaker: control
british/bandits_1_b.text: Sector Control. one bandit inbound, with bombers. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_2.speaker: control
british/bandits_2.text: Sector Control. two bandits inbound. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_2_b.speaker: control
british/bandits_2_b.text: Sector Control. two bandits inbound, with bombers. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_3.speaker: control
british/bandits_3.text: Sector Control. three bandits inbound. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_3_b.speaker: control
british/bandits_3_b.text: Sector Control. three bandits inbound, with bombers. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_4.speaker: control
british/bandits_4.text: Sector Control. four bandits inbound. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_4_b.speaker: control
british/bandits_4_b.text: Sector Control. four bandits inbound, with bombers. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_5.speaker: control
british/bandits_5.text: Sector Control. five bandits inbound. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_5_b.speaker: control
british/bandits_5_b.text: Sector Control. five bandits inbound, with bombers. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_6.speaker: control
british/bandits_6.text: Sector Control. six bandits inbound. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_6_b.speaker: control
british/bandits_6_b.text: Sector Control. six bandits inbound, with bombers. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_7.speaker: control
british/bandits_7.text: Sector Control. seven bandits inbound. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_7_b.speaker: control
british/bandits_7_b.text: Sector Control. seven bandits inbound, with bombers. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_8.speaker: control
british/bandits_8.text: Sector Control. eight bandits inbound. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_8_b.speaker: control
british/bandits_8_b.text: Sector Control. eight bandits inbound, with bombers. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_9.speaker: control
british/bandits_9.text: Sector Control. nine bandits inbound. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_9_b.speaker: control
british/bandits_9_b.text: Sector Control. nine bandits inbound, with bombers. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_10.speaker: control
british/bandits_10.text: Sector Control. ten bandits inbound. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_10_b.speaker: control
british/bandits_10_b.text: Sector Control. ten bandits inbound, with bombers. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_11.speaker: control
british/bandits_11.text: Sector Control. eleven bandits inbound. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_11_b.speaker: control
british/bandits_11_b.text: Sector Control. eleven bandits inbound, with bombers. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_12.speaker: control
british/bandits_12.text: Sector Control. twelve bandits inbound. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_12_b.speaker: control
british/bandits_12_b.text: Sector Control. twelve bandits inbound, with bombers. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_13.speaker: control
british/bandits_13.text: Sector Control. thirteen bandits inbound. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_13_b.speaker: control
british/bandits_13_b.text: Sector Control. thirteen bandits inbound, with bombers. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_14.speaker: control
british/bandits_14.text: Sector Control. fourteen bandits inbound. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_14_b.speaker: control
british/bandits_14_b.text: Sector Control. fourteen bandits inbound, with bombers. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_15.speaker: control
british/bandits_15.text: Sector Control. fifteen bandits inbound. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_15_b.speaker: control
british/bandits_15_b.text: Sector Control. fifteen bandits inbound, with bombers. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_16.speaker: control
british/bandits_16.text: Sector Control. sixteen bandits inbound. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_16_b.speaker: control
british/bandits_16_b.text: Sector Control. sixteen bandits inbound, with bombers. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_17.speaker: control
british/bandits_17.text: Sector Control. seventeen bandits inbound. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_17_b.speaker: control
british/bandits_17_b.text: Sector Control. seventeen bandits inbound, with bombers. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_18.speaker: control
british/bandits_18.text: Sector Control. eighteen bandits inbound. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_18_b.speaker: control
british/bandits_18_b.text: Sector Control. eighteen bandits inbound, with bombers. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_19.speaker: control
british/bandits_19.text: Sector Control. nineteen bandits inbound. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_19_b.speaker: control
british/bandits_19_b.text: Sector Control. nineteen bandits inbound, with bombers. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_20.speaker: control
british/bandits_20.text: Sector Control. twenty bandits inbound. Scrambling another section.

british/bandits_20_b.speaker: control
british/bandits_20_b.text: Sector Control. twenty bandits inbound, with bombers. Scrambling another section.

british/factory_coast_start.speaker: crew
british/factory_coast_start.text: Dutch coast behind us. Aircraft ready, bombs aboard. Take us inland, skipper.

british/factory_no_wingmen.speaker: crew
british/factory_no_wingmen.text: No wingmen answering. We are on our own, skipper.

british/factory_order_suppress.speaker: you
british/factory_order_suppress.text: Strike section, suppress those gun positions. Go in low.

british/factory_order_cover.speaker: you
british/factory_order_cover.text: Strike section, break off. Form up and cover our withdrawal.

british/factory_order_bomb.speaker: you
british/factory_order_bomb.text: Strike section, attack the wireless works. Make your runs.

british/factory_interceptors.speaker: wing
british/factory_interceptors.text: Two fighters coming in from the east! Turn for the coast. Watch our tail!

british/factory_return.speaker: crew
british/factory_return.text: Turning for Hawkinge. Steady as she goes, skipper. Let us get her home.

british/aa_spotted.speaker: crew
british/aa_spotted.text: Gun positions ahead. Keep down. We can silence the light guns with cannon.

british/aa_incoming.speaker: wing
british/aa_incoming.text: Tracers coming up! Break, break! Do not give them a steady target!

british/altitude_warning.speaker: crew
british/altitude_warning.text: We are too high, skipper. The guns have our height. Get her down!

british/factory_final_approach.speaker: control
british/factory_final_approach.text: Hawkinge to Strike Leader. Turn south for the runway. Undercarriage down. You are clear to land.

british/factory_takeoff.speaker: crew
british/factory_takeoff.text: Ready, skipper. Open her up. I will call the coast once we are airborne.

british/factory_coast.speaker: crew
british/factory_coast.text: English coast ahead. Ease her down towards the water.

british/factory_channel.speaker: crew
british/factory_channel.text: Over the Channel now. Keep her low. Watch those wave tops.

british/factory_country.speaker: crew
british/factory_country.text: Dutch countryside ahead. Follow the canals. The works are inland.

british/factory_approach.speaker: crew
british/factory_approach.text: Wireless works ahead. Line her up. Steady, skipper.

british/factory_release.speaker: you
british/factory_release.text: Bombs gone! Eight second delay. Keep going, clear the works!

british/factory_egress.speaker: crew
british/factory_egress.text: Keep her moving! I have got the works behind us. Stand by for the blast.

british/factory_escape.speaker: crew
british/factory_escape.text: We have cleared the target. Turn west, then out to sea. Keep watching our tail.

british/factory_homeward.speaker: crew
british/factory_homeward.text: Homeward across the Channel. Easy on her, skipper. We will nurse her back.

british/factory_landing.speaker: control
british/factory_landing.text: Strike Leader, Hawkinge. Runway ahead. Check your undercarriage. Bring her in.

british/factory_success.speaker: control
british/factory_success.text: Strike Leader, the works are hit and your section is clear. Good show. Bring them home.

british/factory_landed.speaker: crew
british/factory_landed.text: We are down, skipper. Aircraft and crew home in one piece. Well flown.

british/factory_failed.speaker: control
british/factory_failed.text: Strike Leader, the target is still standing. Break off and return to base.

british/mission_aircraft_lost.speaker: wing
british/mission_aircraft_lost.text: Leader is down! Break off. Return to base.

british/escort_intro.speaker: control
british/escort_intro.text: Red Leader, six Bostons crossing the coast. Stay with them to the target and bring them home. Watch the sun. Bandits expected.

british/convoy_intro.speaker: control
british/convoy_intro.text: Strike Leader, convoy ahead. Two merchantmen with an armed escort. Go in low. Suppress the guns, then make your torpedo attack.

british/precision_intro.speaker: control
british/precision_intro.text: Red Leader, the headquarters is your target. Occupied houses alongside. One accurate pass, then straight out to sea. Keep your bombs clear of the houses.

british/intercept_intro.speaker: control
british/intercept_intro.text: Formation ahead. Break up the bombers before they reach the depot. Watch their rear gunners. Escort fighters above.

british/rescue_intro.speaker: control
british/rescue_intro.text: Red Leader, damaged Boston ahead. He cannot keep up. Stay with him across the Channel. Bring that crew home.

british/fortress_intro.speaker: control
british/fortress_intro.text: Mustang Leader, you are with the Fortresses through the bomb run. Keep those fighters off the heavies. Get those crews to the handover.

british/mission_order_engage.speaker: you
british/mission_order_engage.text: Section, take those fighters. Keep them off the bombers.

british/mission_order_close.speaker: you
british/mission_order_close.text: Section, close escort. Stay with the bombers.

british/mission_order_straggler.speaker: you
british/mission_order_straggler.text: Cover the straggler. Stay with him. Watch his tail.

british/mission_order_suppress.speaker: you
british/mission_order_suppress.text: Section, suppress those guns. Give the strike aircraft a clear run.

british/mission_order_cover.speaker: you
british/mission_order_cover.text: Section, break off. Form up and cover me.

british/mission_order_strike.speaker: you
british/mission_order_strike.text: Strike section, torpedo attack. Take the merchantmen. Go in low.

british/mission_order_hold.speaker: you
british/mission_order_hold.text: Section, hold formation. Leave the bombing to me.

british/mission_order_bombers.speaker: you
british/mission_order_bombers.text: Attack the bombers. Break up that formation before they release.

british/mission_order_escorts.speaker: you
british/mission_order_escorts.text: Take the escort fighters. Keep them clear of our attack.

british/fighters_inbound.speaker: wing
british/fighters_inbound.text: Bandits coming in! Cover the bombers. Watch the high side!

british/fighters_final.speaker: wing
british/fighters_final.text: Another attack coming in! Do not leave the bombers. Break into them!

british/precision_fighters.speaker: wing
british/precision_fighters.text: Fighters coming in! Cover the withdrawal. Keep going for the coast!

british/torpedo_hold.speaker: crew
british/torpedo_hold.text: Hold release, skipper. Too far outside the dropping limits. Low and level. Steady her first.

british/convoy_approach.speaker: crew
british/convoy_approach.text: Convoy in sight. Guns on the escort. Line up a merchant and allow for her course.

british/torpedo_away.speaker: crew
british/torpedo_away.text: Torpedo away! Break clear of the ship. Watch for tracers!

british/precision_target.speaker: crew
british/precision_target.text: Headquarters ahead. Houses to the side. Steady on the run. Make this one count.

british/precision_bombs_away.speaker: crew
british/precision_bombs_away.text: Bombs away. Keep clear of the houses. Straight out, skipper!

british/bomber_abort.speaker: wing
british/bomber_abort.text: Taking too much damage. We have to turn back. Aborting the bomb run.

british/bomber_straggler.speaker: wing
british/bomber_straggler.text: Engine trouble. I am falling behind. Stay with me, leader.

british/bomber_bomb_run.speaker: wing
british/bomber_bomb_run.text: Starting the bomb run. Hold formation. Keep those fighters off us.

british/bomber_bombs_away.speaker: wing
british/bomber_bombs_away.text: Bombs away. Keep formation. Stay with us for the turn.

british/escort_homeward.speaker: control
british/escort_homeward.text: Formation turning for home. Stay close. They may have another go at the stragglers.

british/escort_success.speaker: control
british/escort_success.text: Formation across the English coast. You are clear to break off. Good work, Red Leader. Come on home.

british/escort_failed.speaker: control
british/escort_failed.text: Too few of the bombers made it through. Break off the escort and return to base.

british/rescue_success.speaker: wing
british/rescue_success.text: English coast ahead! We are going to make it. Thank you, leader. You brought us home.

british/rescue_failed.speaker: control
british/rescue_failed.text: The Boston is gone. Break off, Red Leader. Return to base.

british/fortress_success.speaker: control
british/fortress_success.text: The heavies are at the handover. You brought those crews through. You are clear to break off, Mustang Leader.

british/fortress_failed.speaker: control
british/fortress_failed.text: We have lost too many of the heavies. Break off the escort. Bring your flight home.

british/convoy_success.speaker: control
british/convoy_success.text: Merchant shipping hit. Strike section clear of the convoy. Good show. Return to base.

british/convoy_failed.speaker: control
british/convoy_failed.text: The merchantmen are still afloat. Torpedoes expended. Break off and return to base.

british/precision_success.speaker: control
british/precision_success.text: Headquarters destroyed. The houses are clear. Good shooting, Red Leader. Return to base.

british/precision_failed.speaker: control
british/precision_failed.text: The headquarters is still standing. Break off. Do not make another pass.

british/precision_collateral.speaker: control
british/precision_collateral.text: Abort the attack. The houses have been hit. Break off and return to base.

british/intercept_success.speaker: control
british/intercept_success.text: The bomber formation is broken. Good work. Disengage and return to base.

british/intercept_failed.speaker: control
british/intercept_failed.text: The bombers have released over the depot. Break off the attack and return to base.

british/kill_factory.speaker: wing
british/kill_factory.text: Good hits on the wireless works. Smoke rising from the halls.

british/kill_ship.speaker: wing
british/kill_ship.text: Direct hit! Merchant going down. Watch those guns as we pull clear!

british/kill_objective.speaker: wing
british/kill_objective.text: Good hits. The target is destroyed.

british/kill_housing.speaker: control
british/kill_housing.text: Occupied housing has been hit. Abort the attack.

british/wingman_down.speaker: wing
british/wingman_down.text: One of our section is going down! Watch out, leader!

british/wingman_landing.speaker: wing
british/wingman_landing.text: Returning to base. Landing to rearm.

american/rearmed.speaker: crew
american/rearmed.text: Fuel topped off. Guns loaded. She is ready to go, Lieutenant.

american/player_down.speaker: wing
american/player_down.text: Mustang Leader is hit! Bail out! Get out of there!

american/aa_spotted.speaker: crew
american/aa_spotted.text: Flak positions ahead. Keep your eyes open. Watch for fighters coming through the bursts.

american/aa_incoming.speaker: wing
american/aa_incoming.text: Tracers coming up! Break, break! Do not give them a steady target!

american/altitude_warning.speaker: crew
american/altitude_warning.text: They have got our altitude. Keep moving. Do not give those gunners a steady target.

american/mission_aircraft_lost.speaker: wing
american/mission_aircraft_lost.text: Leader is down! Break off. Return to base.

american/fortress_intro.speaker: control
american/fortress_intro.text: Mustang Leader, you are with the Fortresses through the bomb run. Keep those fighters off the heavies. Get those crews to the handover.

american/mission_order_engage.speaker: you
american/mission_order_engage.text: Section, take those fighters. Keep them off the bombers.

american/mission_order_close.speaker: you
american/mission_order_close.text: Section, close escort. Stay with the bombers.

american/mission_order_straggler.speaker: you
american/mission_order_straggler.text: Cover the straggler. Stay with him. Watch his tail.

american/mission_order_cover.speaker: you
american/mission_order_cover.text: Section, break off. Form up and cover me.

american/fighters_inbound.speaker: wing
american/fighters_inbound.text: Bandits coming in! Cover the bombers. Watch the high side!

american/fighters_final.speaker: wing
american/fighters_final.text: Another attack coming in! Do not leave the bombers. Break into them!

american/bomber_abort.speaker: wing
american/bomber_abort.text: Taking too much damage. We have to turn back. Aborting the bomb run.

american/bomber_straggler.speaker: wing
american/bomber_straggler.text: Engine trouble. I am falling behind. Stay with me, leader.

american/bomber_bomb_run.speaker: wing
american/bomber_bomb_run.text: Starting the bomb run. Hold formation. Keep those fighters off us.

american/bomber_bombs_away.speaker: wing
american/bomber_bombs_away.text: Bombs away. Keep formation. Stay with us for the turn.

american/escort_homeward.speaker: control
american/escort_homeward.text: The heavies are turning for home. Stay with them. Watch the stragglers. Those fighters may come around again.

american/fortress_success.speaker: control
american/fortress_success.text: The heavies are at the handover. You brought those crews through. You are clear to break off, Mustang Leader.

american/fortress_failed.speaker: control
american/fortress_failed.text: We have lost too many of the heavies. Break off the escort. Bring your flight home.

american/kill_objective.speaker: wing
american/kill_objective.text: Good hits. The target is destroyed.

american/wingman_down.speaker: wing
american/wingman_down.text: One of our section is going down! Watch out, leader!

american/wingman_landing.speaker: wing
american/wingman_landing.text: Returning to base. Landing to rearm.

british/norway_intro.speaker: control
british/norway_intro.text: Coastal Command to Red Leader. Six German merchantmen ahead. Destroyer escort with heavy flak, and a surfaced U-boat. Close in low and use your solid shot rockets against the merchant hulls. Sink at least one, then clear west.

british/norway_approach.speaker: crew
british/norway_approach.text: Ships ahead, skipper. Close to range. Aim for the waterline and keep her steady.

british/norway_rockets_away.speaker: crew
british/norway_rockets_away.text: Rockets away! Watch for strikes. Keep her steady, then break clear, skipper!

british/norway_success.speaker: control
british/norway_success.text: Merchant sunk. Coastal Command confirms the strike. Clear the coast and return to base.

british/norway_failed.speaker: control
british/norway_failed.text: No merchant ships sunk. Break off the attack and return to base.

british/norway_order_strike.speaker: you
british/norway_order_strike.text: Section, attack the merchantmen with rockets. Close to range and break clear after firing.
